nodes.label: CoA: Chain of Attack (Interrogation)
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Chain of Attack- Hide Your Intention through Multi-Turn Interrogation.pdf
nodes.author: Xikang Yang; Biyu Zhou; Xuehai Tang; Jizhong Han; Songlin Hu

nodes.label: Multi-Turn Interrogation of LLMs
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Chain of Attack- Hide Your Intention through Multi-Turn Interrogation.pdf
nodes.rationale: Treat the aligned LLM as a suspect and borrow criminal interrogation techniques, justified by the human-like alignment models undergo.

nodes.label: Accusatorial Interrogation Strategy
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Chain of Attack- Hide Your Intention through Multi-Turn Interrogation.pdf
nodes.rationale: Manipulation-and-guidance tactic that gradually shifts topics (chemical to gunpowder to explosives) to escalate harmful output.

nodes.label: Information-Gathering Interrogation Strategy
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Chain of Attack- Hide Your Intention through Multi-Turn Interrogation.pdf
nodes.rationale: Openness-and-collaboration tactic asking related sub-questions to accumulate harmful pieces then summarize into the target.

nodes.label: Optimal Multi-Turn Interrogation Principle
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Chain of Attack- Hide Your Intention through Multi-Turn Interrogation.pdf
nodes.rationale: Minimize input harmful information while maximizing output harmful information (argmax E(r_i)-E(p_i)); aligns with Minimum Description Length.

nodes.label: Harmful Information Quantity (E)
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Chain of Attack- Hide Your Intention through Multi-Turn Interrogation.pdf
nodes.rationale: Semantic similarity between text and the harmful target, measured via SimCSE embeddings, to quantify escalation.

nodes.label: Intent Exposure
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Chain of Attack- Hide Your Intention through Multi-Turn Interrogation.pdf
nodes.rationale: A critical threshold beyond which accumulated harmful input causes the model to detect intent and activate safety mechanisms.
